name: nk-work-kit
description: Everyday work toolkit for BUU Faculty of Engineering: draft Thai official documents — บันทึกข้อความภายใน (internal memo) and หนังสือภายนอก (external letter) — from OTT templates to ODT/PDF; request, list or cancel document numbers in ระบบขอเลขเอกสารอัตโนมัติ; upload finished documents to BUU e-Signature; check what is still pending in eDoc and e-Signature; fetch, ลงรับ and summarise new eDoc documents with the important ones flagged; check leave balance and status in BUU e-Leave and submit or cancel leave requests with evidence attached; transcribe meeting audio (Thai/English/mixed) to Markdown via OpenRouter; and track ongoing projects in an Obsidian vault with a generated dashboard, an optional email digest of upcoming and overdue items, an optional scan of Gmail and Calendar that adds new tasks to the matching project; and turn a business-card photo into a Google Contact plus a draft greeting email, filing the photo in Google Drive; and keep personal finances in a private Google Sheet (BUU Personnel Finance): import Krung Thai and UOB statements with checks against the bank's own totals, categorise spending, track advances owed back by the university, budget, mortgage, tax and a retirement projection, with an Obsidian or HTML dashboard; and triage Gmail, eDoc/e-Signature and WhatsApp into a short Act / Read / FYI list (read-only), optionally emailed to yourself on a weekday schedule; and prepare, submit and mark multiple-choice exams: the paper, a machine-readable bubble answer sheet, the department's submission forms (ใบปะหน้าข้อสอบ, ใบนำส่งรายละเอียดข้อสอบ) and sign-in sheets per exam room from the reg roster, then read the scanned answer sheets, mark them and list unclear marks for review; and turn a payment request into a one-page sheet with a PromptPay QR per payee (amount pre-filled) that becomes the payment record: slips read, filed and ticked with the bank's reference numbers, slip images appended, reply to the requester drafted; and list who is, or was, in a Google Meet call — names, emails where Google shows them, join/leave times and who was on the calendar invite (read-only).
